name: Xenon 2 Megablast 50fps
description: What if, in an alternative universe, Atari had put arcade-level graphics chips in our beloved Atari ST? In 1989 The Bitmap Brothers released Xenon 2 Megablast, a shocking shoot'em up running at 17 frames a second. In that parallel universe it runs at an insane 50. Almost 40 years later, the SidecarTridge Multi-device takes you there. Learn more
